title: Extended ideal tensor products and categorical images
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], $I$ an ideal sheaf datum on $Y$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], $N$ an $\mathcal O_Y$-module, and $P$ an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Fix an adjunction $a:f^*\dashv f_*$ [def-pc-module-pullback] and an isomorphism $e:f^*N\cong P$. Let $\phi:f^*I\to\mathcal O_X$ be adjoint to the inclusion of $I$ followed by the structure-sheaf map. Let $\mu_P:\operatorname{im}(\phi)\otimes P\to P$ be multiplication, and let $\mu_1:(I\mathcal O_X)\otimes f^*N\to f^*N$ be multiplication for the extended ideal. If $c:f^*\cong f^*$ is the comparison from $a$ to the canonical adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], there exists an additive isomorphism $q:\Gamma(X,\operatorname{im}(\mu_P))\cong\Gamma(X,(I\mathcal O_X)\otimes f^*N)$ satisfying $\mu_1(q(t))=c_N(e^{-1}(\operatorname{im}(\mu_P)\hookrightarrow P)(t))$ for every global section $t$. This is an image identification only, with no assertion that restriction from $Y$ to $X$ is bijective.

proof.text: On affine opens, identify the ideal module with its defining ideal using range_toModulesι_app. The affine pullback comparison sends a pure tensor to the corresponding restricted ideal section times its scalar. Thus the image of the canonical adjoint ideal inclusion is the ideal generated by the original ideal, which is I.comap f by ideal_comap_appLE. This equality is compatible with localization and glues to equality of the image subsheaf and the extended ideal module. Changing the adjunction precomposes the adjoint ideal inclusion by an isomorphism, so does not change this image. Explicitly, if c compares adj to the canonical adjunction, φ = c_I.hom composed with the canonical φ, so its image is unchanged without flatness.

Identify image φ with K.toModules, K = I.comap f, preserving the inclusions. Tensoring its monic inclusion with P is monic, hence imageMonoIsoSource identifies the source of μP with image μP. Set h = e.inv composed with c_N.hom. Both P and f* N are invertible, and tensoring the identity of K.toModules with h is an isomorphism. Naturality of the left unitor gives the inclusion square with ambient map h. Compose this tensor isomorphism with the image-source isomorphism, then evaluate on the top open. The inclusion square is exactly the required equality. Monicity of the target multiplication proves uniqueness of q.

theorem ideal_tensor_image_comparison {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (I : Y.IdealSheafData) (N : Y.Modules) (P : X.Modules) [P.IsInvertible]
    (adj : tensorPullback f ⊣ pushforward f)
    (e : (tensorPullback f).obj N ≅ P) :
    let φ := (adj.homEquiv I.toModules (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).symm
      (I.toModulesι ≫ SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom)
    let μP := image.ι φ ▷ P ≫ (λ_ P).hom
    let N₁ := (tensorPullback f).obj N
    let μ₁ := (I.comap f).toModulesι ▷ N₁ ≫ (λ_ N₁).hom
    let c := adj.leftAdjointUniq (Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction f))
    ∃ q : Γ(image μP, ⊤) ≃+ Γ((I.comap f).toModules ⊗ N₁, ⊤),
      ∀ t, μ₁.app ⊤ (q t) =
        (c.app N).hom.app ⊤ (e.inv.app ⊤ ((image.ι μP).app ⊤ t))
